findings.label: Dead label prop and stale call-site comments in sign-in.tsx
findings.detail: PillButton destructures `label` at line 128 and renders only `action` in both the <a> and <button> branches, but src/pages/account/sign-in.tsx still passes label="Sign in" at both call sites, under comments that describe the retired shape in detail: 'THE TWO-SEGMENT PILL ... The LEFT segment is the static "Sign in" label' and 'Same two-segment pill. The right segment carries "Confirm code"'. The rendered behaviour is correct - one .pill-action span reading exactly 'Confirm code' - but the documentation describes a component shape that 1c847107 removed, in the exact file a reader opens to understand the reported 'Sign inConfirm code' symptom. Upstream's, not this delta's: git diff origin/stack --name-only -- src/components src/pages src/lib amplify is empty.
findings.action: Drop the inert label prop at both sign-in call sites or rewrite the two comments to describe the single-segment pill. Not this branch's work; record it for whoever owns sign-in.tsx.

findings.label: run is cast `as typeof it` in PillButtonBuildScope.test.ts
findings.detail: The skip wrapper is `const run: typeof it = skipReason === null ? it : ( ( name, fn ) => it.skip( `${name} [${skipReason}]`, fn ) ) as typeof it`. The assertion claims a two-argument arrow is the whole `it` callable-with-properties, so `run.each(...)` or `run.only(...)` would type-check and crash at runtime. Inert today because nothing in the file uses them, and tsc --noEmit passes precisely because the cast suppresses the structural check that would catch a later addition.
findings.action: Type the helper as the call signature it actually implements rather than asserting the full `it` interface.

findings.label: Ordering coverage is on a synthetic fixture, not on PillButton
findings.detail: The three new cases in PillButtonAccessibleName.test.tsx render a hand-written <button> with two spans and an overriding aria-label, because PillButton can no longer express either failing shape - ariaLabel was removed and the second segment is gone, and the file asserts both absences. So the ordering clause is proven of the predicate and of Testing Library's name computation, not of the component. Given the constraint this is the only available measurement and it is documented, but the seventeen-case count should not be read as seventeen cases about the pill.
findings.action: No change required now. If a second segment ever returns to PillButton, move the ordering assertion onto the component.

findings.label: No live OTP round trip
findings.detail: Both defects are verified in Chrome 154 over CDP against the real webpack export, but Cognito InitiateAuth, Cognito RespondToAuthChallenge and POST /api/ecommerce/customer-session are all intercepted with Fetch.fulfillRequest, so the deployed path has never been exercised end to end with a real WhatsApp code. The server fix is live (wecare-customer-session v5->v6, wecare-checkout v4->v5, wecare-wix-store v33->v34, recorded in a4144896 by another session, shared layer first), which makes this a confirmation gap rather than a correctness one. Correctly not attempted: no live-send flag may be touched and a real code needs the owner's handset.
